title: BNA Clean Slate - Reconcile Queues and Prove the Next Ramble

source_statements.source_statement: Verify reported release truth against Git, GitHub, Railway, live readback, issue #18, and secrets audit before queue cleanup.
Repair active-run truth so latest.json and run metadata reflect the clean-slate handoff without reopening terminal release runs.
Classify active Tasks, Decisions, requirements, and queue records; keep real blockers visible and do not hide REQ-20260624-028.
Keep REQ-20260624-028 active, linked to GitHub issue #18, read-only, and not approved for production backfill.
Run canonical run/queue validation, raw watchdog, stale evidence validation, JSON/JSONL parsing, secrets audit, and git diff check.
Prove a synthetic next ramble through the real canonical intake path with mapping, dedupe, Decisions, idempotency, and no production pollution.
Create an owner-facing walkthrough with exact live links and role distinctions.
Inventory and preserve local-only worktrees and branches, especially the shared Vimeo checkout.
Write GitHub-visible final handoff, update start files, push PR, merge, and avoid unnecessary docs-only Railway deploy.
